description_en: Unbinds non-Alibaba Cloud servers from Security Center
description_zh: 解除云安全中心绑定的非阿里云服务器
name: UnbindAegis

parameters.help_en:
The UUIDs of the non-Alibaba Cloud servers that you want to unbind. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要解除绑定的非阿里服务器的UUID。存在多个UUID时使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuids

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each API request. You can use the request ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
